**Architecture changes are proposed as ADRs, not issues.**

CONTRIBUTING.md's architecture-decisions section has the exact steps: copy
`docs/adr/0000-template.md`, assign the next number, and submit the ADR
alongside (or ahead of) the change it governs. An accepted ADR is immutable
-- superseded by a new ADR, never rewritten.

Use this issue only to stage the discussion before that PR exists: state
the problem the current architecture doesn't handle, and why it needs a new
or amended ADR rather than an ordinary feature or bug fix. Link the ADR PR
here once it's open.
